meta.project: Playwright E2E Suite — Firebase Emulators (B2B / Educational / Personal)

product_overview: End-to-end test suite (Playwright) that validates critical business flows for B2B (Enterprise), Educational, and Personal users against a local backend running with Firebase emulators. Tests include environment/global setup, seeding a Super Admin, registration/invite/password-setup flows, document analysis and validation, and happy/error paths for each user type.
core_goals: Provide a reproducible Playwright E2E test suite that runs against local Firebase emulators (Firestore & Auth).
Ensure Playwright and the frontend use Firestore long-polling or adjusted timeouts to avoid CI websocket failures.
Cover the three primary user flows: B2B (Admin -> Owner -> Worker), Educational (edu domain registration + validation), and Personal (natural/RUN registration).
Detect and report missing server-side validation or behavioral gaps (e.g., missing edu-domain validation) as potential bugs before test implementation.
Deliver Playwright config, global setup to launch emulators, and generated .spec.ts tests for all required scenarios.

features.name: Global Environment Setup
features.description: Start Firebase emulators, configure Playwright for long-polling/timeouts and seed initial data (Super Admin) before running tests.
user_flows: Start Firebase emulators (Firestore on localhost:8085, Auth on localhost:9099) -> Run Playwright globalSetup script that forces long polling or increased timeouts -> Launch backend and confirm it's reachable by GET /health -> Seed Super Admin into the Firestore emulator (direct emulator write) -> Confirm Super Admin seed succeeded by reading Firestore directly

Start Firebase emulators -> Attempt to run Playwright without long-polling configuration -> Observe intermittent Firestore websocket timeouts or failing connections -> Fail test run and log 'use long polling' error

features.name: B2B (Empresa) lifecycle: Admin -> Owner -> Worker
features.description: Validate Admin creates a company, invites an Owner, Owner sets up password and logs in, then Owner creates a Worker and Worker sees only permitted modules.
user_flows: Call GET /health -> Login as seeded Super Admin (token via emulator) -> POST /api/auth/invite with owner email and company metadata -> Receive invite token (emulator: read invite record) -> POST /api/auth/tunnel/challenge with invite token -> POST /api/auth/tunnel/setup-password with chosen password -> POST /api/admin/login with Owner credentials -> Navigate to owner dashboard -> Owner creates Worker (frontend action) -> Worker logs in using credentials -> Worker views dashboard and sees only permitted modules (observation)
Login as Super Admin -> POST /api/auth/invite with malformed email -> Receive validation error response (400) -> Confirm invite not created (emulator: no invite record)
POST /api/auth/invite without Super Admin auth -> Receive 401/403 response -> Confirm invite not permitted

features.name: Invitation & Password Tunnel (invite / setup)
features.description: Flows around sending invites (B2B) and completing account setup via tunnel endpoints.
user_flows: Authenticated Admin calls POST /api/auth/invite -> System writes invite record in emulator -> Invitee requests challenge by POST /api/auth/tunnel/challenge -> System returns challenge token -> POST /api/auth/tunnel/setup-password with token and password -> System activates account -> Attempt to POST /api/admin/login with new credentials -> Login succeeds
Authenticated Admin calls POST /api/auth/invite with an already-registered email -> System returns conflict (409) error -> Invite not created
POST /api/auth/tunnel/setup-password with invalid/expired token -> System returns 400/401 -> Account not activated

features.name: Educational lifecycle: .edu (registration, doc analysis, validation)
features.description: Register an educational user using an institutional domain, run document analysis, and validate education requests (admin workflow).
user_flows: Navigate to registration UI -> POST /api/auth/register with email user@university.edu and required fields -> Backend registers account and classifies role as EDUCATIONAL or PENDING_VALIDATION -> If classification is PENDING_VALIDATION, submit supporting document via POST /api/edu/analyze-doc -> System returns analysis result -> Admin authenticated calls POST /api/edu/validate/:requestId to approve -> User role changes to EDUCATIONAL -> User logs in and sees educational dashboard

Navigate to registration UI -> POST /api/auth/register with email user@university.edu -> If backend lacks domain-checking logic, registration proceeds as Personal -> Detect missing validation logic and flag 'Potential Bug: no edu-domain classification' (product/reporting action)

Navigate to registration UI -> POST /api/auth/register with email user@gmail.com while using the educational flow -> System rejects or classifies as PERSONAL -> Registration completes under personal account (negative case expected)

features.name: Document analysis & education validation APIs
features.description: APIs that analyze uploaded educational documents and allow authorized validation of education requests.
user_flows: User uploads document from UI -> POST /api/edu/analyze-doc with document payload -> System returns analysis metadata and requestId -> Admin authenticates and POST /api/edu/validate/:requestId -> System marks request validated -> User role updated to EDUCATIONAL
User uploads corrupted/unsupported document -> POST /api/edu/analyze-doc -> System returns analysis failure/error -> UI displays validation error and prevents auto-approval

features.name: Personal user lifecycle (natural person with RUN/RUT)
features.description: Register a personal/natural user (RUT/RUN + generic email) and ensure immediate access to personal dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to registration UI -> POST /api/auth/register with valid RUN/RUT and generic email user@gmail.com -> System registers account and assigns PERSONAL role -> User logs in and sees basic personal dashboard
Navigate to registration UI -> POST /api/auth/register with invalid/malformed RUN/RUT -> System returns validation error (400) -> Registration blocked

features.name: Public checks & branding (supporting flows)
features.description: Public endpoints used during onboarding and presence checks (branding, account existence by taxId).
user_flows: GET /api/settings/branding -> Receive branding settings for the frontend -> Frontend renders organization brand
GET /api/public/accounts-by-id/:taxId with existing taxId -> Receive account existence true -> Continue B2B onboarding
GET /api/public/accounts-by-id/:taxId with non-existing taxId -> Receive not found/false -> Frontend shows 'create new company' path
